pages.text: Remove a list and a optional number, then randomize order of lists contents up to a certain degree wich might be limited by the number.
Remove a list and a positive number, and returns a list with every nth element removed.
$(br)Remove a list, a positive integer, and either a single element or a list of elements. Replaces every nth element in the original list with the provided elements.
If the replacement list runs out, returns the modified list along with the number of unfilled positions.
